title: iwlwifi firmware crashes on boot sometimes, after ~one hour otherwise
body: I've been using Arch for around a year now, and suddenly my wifi started disconnecting randomly. After some reboots, it didn't start automatically and I needed to use ip link set wlan0 up every once in a while to get it up and running. However, now sometimes it doesn't show up on ip link anymore, even on reboot. The actual network card is a Intel Corporation Wireless-AC 9560 [part of a HP ProBook x360 11 G5 EE (SBKPF)], which lspci -k reports spendidly: ... 00:0c.0 Network controller: Intel Corporation Gemini Lake PCH CNVi WiFi (rev 06) Subsystem: Intel Corporation Wireless-AC 9560 Kernel driver in use: iwlwifi Kernel modules: iwlwifi ... I used NetworkManager for my connections, but I don't think thats the issue. I believe I've narrowed it down to firmware issues, as dmesg spits out stuff like Microcode SW error detected.
